description:
See an Anthill Chamber through your seat ticket: the deadline, every seat (joined, name, reserved_for, promised fingerprint, deposited) and the state (waiting, released or failed). Free; no profile needed.
Before release it never shows anything about the other deposits. Once released, it lists a ticket for each other seat's deposit: collect them with anthill_retrieve (free, already paid), or give a person the view_url. It also returns a signed release receipt listing every deposit's fingerprint: proof of exactly what was exchanged.

seat_ticket.description: Your seat ticket (starts with 'chm_'), from anthill_chamber_join.
